findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when TopicUser row is missing
findings.body: In TopicsController#unsubscribe the code does TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id]) then immediately calls tu.notification_level. find_by returns nil when the user has no row for the topic, for example a user who was @mentioned or mailed but never visited. That raises NoMethodError on nil and returns 500 instead of unsubscribing. It must handle nil via TopicUser.change or find-or-create.

findings.title: State-changing unsubscribe on GET enables CSRF/prefetch unsubscribe
findings.body: TopicsController#unsubscribe is routed as GET in config/routes.rb but mutates notification_level and saves. Browsers, email link scanners, and crawlers prefetch GETs, and an attacker can embed the URL as an image to force a logged-in victim's browser to unsubscribe with no CSRF token. Safe methods must not mutate; GET should render confirmation and mutation should require POST/PUT.

findings.title: Per-topic email link requires login so logged-out clicks fail
findings.body: TopicsController#unsubscribe is in the ensure_logged_in list, yet the URL is mailed as a one-click unsubscribe link. A recipient who clicks while logged out, on another device, or after session expiry is redirected to login and never unsubscribed. The existing global unsubscribe uses email/unsubscribe/:key token auth for this reason; the per-topic link needs token auth or it is dead on arrival for logged-out users.

findings.title: Watching/tracking users are only downgraded, not unsubscribed
findings.body: The code sets notification_level to regular when it is greater than regular, else to muted. A watching (3) or tracking (2) user who clicks the email promise to stop receiving notifications about this topic is left at regular (1), which still generates reply/mention/watch emails. It takes a second visit to reach muted. It should set muted directly for an email unsubscribe.

findings.title: Direct TopicUser save bypasses reason, timestamp and live update
findings.body: The action assigns tu.notification_level and calls tu.save! instead of TopicUser.change used by set_notifications. That skips setting notifications_changed_at, notifications_reason_id, and publishing MessageBus notification_level_change. The result is stale audit fields and open topic pages/tracking state that do not update live, diverging from all other notification-level changes.

findings.title: List-Unsubscribe header not updated to per-topic URL
findings.body: The email body now includes a per-topic unsubscribe_url, but header_args still sets List-Unsubscribe to only user_preferences_url even when unsubscribe_url is present. Email clients that use the header for one-click unsubscribe will send the user to generic preferences instead of unsubscribing from the topic, making header and body inconsistent and defeating the feature for those clients.

findings.title: No test verifies per-topic unsubscribe URL or controller behavior
findings.body: The spec adds unsubscribe_url to the builder fixture but only asserts the generic user_preferences_url in the body and presence of the header. Nothing asserts the body/header contain the per-topic unsubscribe_url, and there is no controller test for TopicsController#unsubscribe covering missing TopicUser, downgrade-vs-mute, login/token, or GET side effects, so the bugs above ship undetected.
